name: Đất Phú Gen 4 - B2B AI Sales Bot (Zalo/FB + Supabase + Gemini JSON + VietQR)

parameters.query:
SELECT c.ai_system_prompt, c.bank_code, c.bank_account_number, c.bank_account_name, c.items_catalog, m.id as merchant_id, m.business_name 
FROM public.b2b_bot_configs c 
JOIN public.b2b_merchants m ON c.merchant_id = m.id 
WHERE c.zalo_oa_id = '{{ $json.body.oa_id }}' AND c.is_active = true AND c.human_handoff_until < NOW() 
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Node 3: Google AI Studio (Gemini JSON Output)

parameters.query:
